continuationReal.$comment: Read by json_get_or_register: a JSON real, an array of JSON reals, or a constants name, which the lookup resolves to a real or to an array of reals (a name is accepted for either, as the schema cannot see the constant). An integer, boolean or object aborts (continuation_scheduler.f90:160); array elements must be reals (case_file_utils.f90:347 in Neko); an empty array reads values(1) of a zero-size array (continuation_scheduler.f90:153).
continuationReal.description: A real, a non-empty array of reals stepped through by the continuation scheduler, or the name of a real or vector constant.

continuationIterations.$comment: Read with the integer lookup (continuation_scheduler.f90:155): a JSON integer or the name of an integer constant. Values <= 0 are accepted and disable the schedule (continuation_scheduler.f90:248).

pointZoneName.$comment: Passed to the point-zone registry as is; an empty string means no mask (sources/problem/objective.f90:151).
